name: GOV.UK footer
summary: Use the official GOV.UK footer on authorised GOV.UK services for service links, licensing and Crown copyright information.
whenToUse: Use the official footer on services that are part of GOV.UK and authorised to use its identity and standard licensing statements.
Add only useful service links, grouped into navigation sections when there are enough links to justify them.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Crown identity or licensing claims for content that is not covered by them.
Do not recreate or redistribute crown and licensing artwork from these documentation records; consume the official GOV.UK Frontend component and assets.

anatomy.name: Footer container
anatomy.description: A semantic footer aligns its content to the GOV.UK width container.

anatomy.name: Navigation sections
anatomy.description: Optional headings and lists group useful service links.

anatomy.name: Meta links
anatomy.description: A compact list contains service policies and other secondary destinations.

anatomy.name: Licence and copyright
anatomy.description: Official assets and wording describe applicable content licensing and Crown copyright.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: Licence, copyright and a small set of meta links.

variants.name: With navigation
variants.use: Add organised link columns when a service has several persistent destinations.

behaviour: The Footer requires no GOV.UK JavaScript and all destinations must be ordinary links.
Use the official template or macro so identity, licence markup and assets stay aligned with the pinned release.
Do not copy protected identity SVG data into framework adapters or generated DESIGN.md files.
accessibility: Use a semantic footer landmark and heading levels that fit the surrounding page.
Give each navigation group a clear heading and keep link text descriptive.
Preserve the official link focus treatments and accessible handling of decorative assets.
content: Include only links users reasonably expect to find across the whole service.
Keep official licence and copyright wording unchanged unless legal guidance for the service requires a different statement.
Do not imply Crown ownership or Open Government Licence coverage where it does not apply.

htmlExamples.name: Official macro required
